e-01.title: Join two library notice lines to check Ben plan
e-01.goal: Join two different lines for di notice (normal opening days and this week exception), decide day by day whether your friend plan fit work, then explain for English.
e-01.material:
Notice for di school library door (na only writing, no picture):

Library
Open: Mon, Wed, Fri  3:00-4:00
This week: closed on Friday (cleaning day).

Your friend Ben talk say, "Let's go to the library on Thursday and on Friday this week!"
e-01.thinking.0: Join different notice lines before you decide
e-01.thinking.1: Find evidence for each day separately
e-01.thinking.2: Use evidence to check your friend plan
e-01.prereq.0: English words for days of di week (Mon, Tue ... )
e-01.s.s1.prompt: Ben fit use di library for both Thursday and Friday this week as di plan talk?
e-01.s.s1.hint.0: Check Thursday and Friday separately. Compare wetin each notice line talk about each day.
e-01.s.s1.hint.1: Check whether di 'Open' line and di 'This week' line dey do different work.
e-01.s.s1.r.a: You fit never read both notice lines. Check whether Thursday dey for opening days and whether special information dey about Friday.
e-01.s.s1.o.b: None of di two days fit work.
e-01.s.s1.r.c: Normally Friday na opening day, but di 'This week' line talk different thing for this week.
e-01.s.s1.r.d: Check again whether Thursday dey for di opening days list (Open).
e-01.s.s1.explain: Thursday no dey for di opening days (Mon, Wed, Fri). Normally Friday na opening day, but this week di notice talk 'closed on Friday'. So none of di two days fit work.
e-01.s.s2.prompt: Choose all di lines wey you need to judge Ben plan (Thursday and Friday).
e-01.s.s2.hint.0: Try remove each line and check whether e go hard to decide about Thursday or Friday.
e-01.s.s2.hint.1: Separate Ben proposal from di notice lines.
e-01.s.s2.r.a: This line fit help you judge Thursday, but e alone no tell you about this week Friday (normally Friday na opening day). Check whether you need another line.
e-01.s.s2.o.b: This week: closed on Friday (cleaning day).
e-01.s.s2.r.b: You need this line for Friday, but e no talk about Thursday. Find di line wey fit help you judge Thursday.
e-01.s.s2.r.c: Na title only; e no give information about di days.
e-01.s.s2.o.d: Let's go to the library on Thursday and on Friday this week!
e-01.s.s2.r.d: Na Ben proposal be this. Na di proposal you need check; proposal no be evidence say e correct.
e-01.s.s2.explain: Di Open line show say Thursday no be opening day. Di This week line show say Friday go close this week. Just one line no fit settle both days. If you choose only one, check which day never get evidence.
e-01.s.s3.prompt: Answer Ben with one or two English sentences. Explain separately why Thursday and Friday no fit work.
e-01.s.s3.hint.0: First write one sentence to tell Ben say di plan no fit work.
e-01.s.s3.hint.1: Write di Thursday reason and Friday reason separately, and connect each reason to di right notice line.
e-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: I give reason for Thursday and reason for Friday?
e-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: I fit point to di notice line wey support each reason?
e-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: If I suggest another day, I check say di library really dey open that day? (Optional)
e-01.s.s3.model.0: No, we can't go on either day. The library is not open on Thursday, and it is closed on Friday this week.
e-01.s.s3.model.1: Sorry, Ben. Thursday is not a library day, and Friday is closed for cleaning. Let's go on Monday!
e-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: This answer even suggest another day.
e-01.s.s3.humanReview: Person need check whether di reasons agree with di notice (Thursday no dey for opening days, Friday closed this week) and whether di English natural. Di automatic check only looks for days and negative expressions.
e-01.s.s3.check.w1.label: E mention Thursday (Thu)
e-01.s.s3.check.w2.label: E mention Friday (Fri)
e-01.s.s3.check.w3.label: E talk say di plan no fit work or di library closed
e-01.s.s3.check.w4.label: Di answer no agree with Ben plan, and e no talk say Friday dey open
